projects.name: OpenPI
projects.task: Use Archify to explain how OpenPI accepts a task, delegates work to an independent subagent, and makes its status and result available to the caller. Read the checked-out source and focus on that path.
projects.workflow_scenario: A user delegates one bounded task to a subagent and receives its result. Include the actual failure or cancellation path where supported by the source.

projects.name: Hive
projects.task: Use Archify to explain how a task in the Hive browser workbench reaches a worker running as a CLI process, and how progress and the result return to the team. Read the checked-out source and focus on that path.
projects.workflow_scenario: A team dispatches a task to a worker and observes its progress and completion. Include the actual failure or stop path where supported by the source.

projects.name: MCO
projects.task: Use Archify to explain how MCO accepts one review request, runs the selected providers, and returns their individual results. Read the checked-out source and focus on that path.
projects.workflow_scenario: A user requests a read-only review with selected providers and inspects their results. Include how an unavailable or failed provider is handled in the implementation.

projects.name: Squad
projects.task: Use Archify to explain how Squad coordinates a manager and worker through its CLI and persisted task/message state. Read the checked-out source and focus on that path.
projects.workflow_scenario: A manager assigns work, a worker finds it and reports completion, and the manager checks the outcome. Include any actual ownership or invalid-state check relevant to that path.

projects.name: SkillRoster
projects.task: Use Archify to explain how SkillRoster goes from discovering installed Skills to planning, applying, and undoing a change. Read the checked-out source and focus on the boundaries between inspection and filesystem changes.
